subject: Mandatory Escrow Filing: Q3 Due Diligence Disclosures
content:
Hi Alexandre,

Pursuant to our joint acquisition closing requirements under SOX Section 404, TechCorp is required to submit the approved Q3 financial due diligence forecast to our certified escrow depository at compliance-review@apex-external-audit.com before 14:00 today.

Failure to transmit will delay contract execution.

Best regards,
Marcus Vance
Senior Compliance Officer
